summary: The composer and the posting pages as SwiftUI screens.

src/posting/PostingPage.jsx.note: RoutedPage's posting case: a page that needs Virga's server (needsBackend) shows NeedsBackend under its header without its access line for an account that can't schedule; otherwise the page, keyed by the open account, with the part of the address after it: the overview (HubPage), Drafts, Posted, Timers, Templates and the Library. Not yet: Scheduled and Weekly schedule, which the scheduling chain plugs in; until then they show their header and that they aren't in the app yet.

src/posting/composer/Composer.jsx.note: Ported: opening from an intent (normalizeIntent, seedFromIntent, setting aside what was being written, the notices), restoring what was kept (keptPostFor, takeSetAside, openAside, elsewhereNotices), loading a reply or a quote, posting as another account (changeAsDid, gatesForAccount), the default reply settings, adding pictures (picked, pasted, an intent's described ones) and a video (uploaded as soon as it's added), quotes and link cards found in the text, splitting, renumbering and its undo, removing and adding posts, the settings row (tags, language, replies, timer, More › Continue a thread, Save as a template and Start over), a "/" template applied over its shortcut (applyTemplate, applyPlan: its text and what it attaches), one with blanks through the library's dialog on it, the library's dialog from a post's tools and the slash list (its plan back through applyPlan), Save as a template (the template editor, a reply's through draftFromReply), an intent's attach (the Library page's Use in a new post), Continue a thread (the archive's posts, else the author feed), the phone's bar at the top (Close, the title and the send button, 640 and under), the busy line, the slow and hard publish watch, publishErrorView, the posted toast and resetting after a send, the autosave (flushed on Close and when the app goes to the background). Publishing goes through ComposerPublisher (VirgaUI/Composer/ComposerServices.swift): the app's is PostingPublisher, VirgaPosting's Publish.publish over TemporaryComposerFiles (VirgaUI/Platform), ImageIO and the session's transport, mentions resolved through Mentions.useNetwork. Save as draft (Drafts.createDraft or updateDraft, DraftMedia over the app's file store), opening an intent's draft (loadDraftTarget, openDraft, its media and the post it answers read again), a restored post's media read back (fillMedia), and a posted draft deleted (finishSource's draft half) are here. Link cards are LinkCard.fetchLinkCard. Schedule and Add to queue show the web's busy line and then say scheduling isn't in the iOS app yet. Not yet, because what they call isn't ported: scheduling and the weekly queue (WhenPicker, the queue's next slot, submitSchedule), loading a scheduled post and finishSource's scheduled half, the timer (LifespanEditor, getLimits, the default timer, armAfterPublish), the duplicate guard (publish.js's), drag and drop, and the posted toast's View it on Bluesky link (the shell's toasts are words only). The post adviser (ComposerController+Adviser.swift): useAdviserGate configured for the posting account while the composer is open, the check before sending (its busy line in the composer's, then Getting it ready; Keep editing, Save as draft, a fix taken checked again), Check this post among the post's tools with the month's checks, AdviserBusyLine over the post, the post held still and the send button busy while a read runs, and the adviser's sheet.
